channel.title: nonsportsphd
channel.description: Obsessively researched deep dives into nonsports trading cards and collectibles.

item.title: Don Celender’s Artist Trading Cards: Artball and Beyond
item.description: Conceptual artist Don Celender turned the 1970s art world into baseball cards, a football playing card deck, and holy cards. Complete checklists for all three, the first appearances hiding in them, and photos of the cards.

item.title: The 2014 Laurence King The Art Game: An Overlooked Treasure for Non-Sport Card Collectors
item.description: Jean-Michel Basquiat, Banksy, Damien Hirst and Jeff Koons all made their trading card debuts in a 2014 art card game. How to tell the first edition from the reissue, both checklists, and the key cards.

item.title: Ranking the Ten Harry Potter “Magic Will Happen” Vending Cards
item.description: A ranking of the ten Harry Potter character cards from the “Magic Will Happen” vending machine set, judged on artwork, appeal and place in Harry Potter trading card history.

item.title: The Hunt for the First Harry Potter Card: A Field Guide to 2000-2001
item.description: A full survey of every Harry Potter card and card-adjacent release from 2000 and 2001, with sourcing, aesthetics ratings, and a personal ranking.
